notes.title: Major technical update of the demo version
notes.content: [p]Full list of changes:[/p][list][*][p]Completely reworked input system[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Full gamepad support - now it's comfortable to play on a controller, including full interface control![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Interface update - tips have been reworked, new elements have been added, the control settings window has been improved. Now you can customize the gamepad for yourself.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]7 new text localizations: Japanese, Chinese (simplified), German, French, Spanish, Ukrainian, Kazakh.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Bug fixes - minor issues with collisions, display of objects and gameplay elements have been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your support and feedback![/p]

notes.title: Technical update #2
notes.content: [p]The following changes have been made to the demo version of ASPIS:[/p][p][b]Content:[/b][/p][list][*][p]One of the previously inaccessible institute rooms has been unlocked.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Sound:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Some sound effects have been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Added sound for the PEP-01 device.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gameplay and interface:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The PEP-01 now captures X-spheres by pressing the button, without having to hold it down.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the logic of the circular menu for selecting equipment.[/p][/*][*][p]Visibility in dark areas has been improved, the brightness of the flashlight has been increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a mouse inversion setting for the X and Y axes.[/p][/*][*][p]The maximum FOV has been increased to 120°.[/p][/*][*][p]Pause now actually pauses the game instead of just bringing up the UI.[/p][/*][*][p]When receiving a new task, its text is now displayed on the screen, and not just the indicator.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Screen resolution support:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added 3440x1440 and 3840x1080 resolutions.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Other:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Minor bug fixes[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Technical update of the demo version
notes.content:
[olist]
[*]New loading system: now you can choose the episode to start the game from.
[*]Additional settings: the menu now includes options for mouse inversion, changing the viewing angle, and adjusting the camera shake.
[*]Ultrawide screen support: 5160x2160 resolution has been added.
[*]Other minor fixes
[/olist]

Thank you for your feedback and support!

notes.title: Fire Fix & Subtitles Update
notes.content:
The update fixes a number of issues that interfere with the demo version:

-Fixed playback of Russian subtitles instead of English in a phone conversation in the first location

-Fixed a common bug with extinguishing a fire in a warehouse

-Fixed an error loading the game after the scene with a fire

Thank you for your feedback! It helps to make the game better step by step. If you notice any more problems - write in the discussions.
